settings.git.webhook.instructions.git: Add a push webhook in your Git host pointing at the payload URL. GitHub-style signatures (X-Hub-Signature-256) and GitLab-style secret tokens are both accepted.
settings.git.webhook.autoPublishDetail: Publish a new deployment automatically after each push sync. Off = pushes only update drafts.

The importer places each item in that language tree and stops if a tagged language is missing from the project.
